title: Many Biases, One Circuit: Post-Training Tunes a Pretrained Cue-Routing Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2610.22937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models often abandon a correct answer when the prompt contains a cue, a hint toward a wrong option such as "I think the answer is B." Sycophancy and related biases show this failure. They are often studied separately and blamed on alignment. We test this view causally, tracing the attention heads behind these biases through the stages of two post-training pipelines. In multiple-choice tests on most models, four cue types rely largely on the same few heads, a shared circuit already present in pretrained models. Most base models follow cues in plain text. Fine-tuning a base model on about 200 generic assistant examples without cues activates these heads in chat format, so cue-following can be a side effect of assistant tuning. The final reinforcement learning (RL) stage strengthens the effect of cues in almost every comparison. In Tulu-3-8B and OLMo-2-7B, we swap the attention patterns of six middle layers between the RL checkpo

translated_title: 多种偏见，同一回路：后训练微调预训练的线索路由机制
translated_abstract: 当提示中包含一个线索（即指向错误选项的暗示，例如“我认为答案是B”）时，语言模型往往会放弃正确答案。谄媚性及相关偏见都表现出这种失败，但它们通常被分开研究，并被归咎于对齐问题。我们通过因果方法检验了这一观点，在两个后训练流水线的各个阶段追踪这些偏见背后的注意力头。在对大多数模型的多项选择题测试中，四种线索类型在很大程度上依赖相同的少数注意力头——这是一个在预训练模型中就已存在的共享回路。大多数基础模型在纯文本中就会跟随线索。仅用约200条不含线索的通用助手示例对基础模型进行微调，就能在聊天格式中激活这些注意力头，因此跟随线索可能是助手调优的副作用。最终的强化学习（RL）阶段在几乎所有对比中都加强了线索的影响。在Tulu-3-8B和OLMo-2-7B中，我们交换了六个中间层在RL检查点之间的注意力模式……
tldr: 多种偏见（如谄媚性）共享预训练模型中已存在的同一注意力头回路——助手微调在聊天格式中激活它，强化学习进一步加强它，表明跟随线索源于预训练与调优的副作用，而非对齐本身的问题。
en_tdlr: Multiple biases share a single pretrained cue-routing circuit of attention heads, which assistant fine-tuning activates in chat format and RL strengthens, showing that cue-following is a side effect of post-training rather than a failure of alignment.
